Based on the provided 500x400 pixel crop of the settings screen, here is a description of the elements from top to bottom:

*   **Top Menu Bar (y: 0–80):** At the very top, there is a standard application menu bar containing the text labels "File", "Edit", "View", and "Help" arranged horizontally.
*   **'Back to app' Row (x: 0–330, y: ~150–210):** On the left side, below the menu bar, is a navigation row containing the text "app". This appears to be a link or button to return to the main application interface.
*   **Search Input (x: 0–330, y: ~250–330):** Directly below the 'Back to app' row on the left is a text input field. It currently contains the placeholder or typed text "settings...".
*   **Sidebar Navigation List (x: 0–330, y: ~430–990):** Below the search input is a vertical list of navigation options. Visible items include "Appearance", "Localization", "Keyboard shortcuts", and "Usage & billing".
*   **Main Content Header (x: 390–550, y: ~140–210):** In the upper portion of the right pane, there is a large header titled "General".
*   **Group Header: Build and compatibility (x: 440–810, y: ~350–420):** The first section in the main content area is headed by the bold text "Build and compatibility".
*   **Detail Text (x: 440–990, y: ~450–560):** Under the first group header, there are lines of text displaying version information: "codexRS 0.1.0-rc.13" and "Behavioral reference: Codex Desktop 26...".
*   **Group Header: Official Codex runtime (x: 440–800, y: ~650–720):** Further down, a second section is headed by the bold text "Official Codex runtime".
*   **Detail Text (x: 440–990, y: ~760–930):** Under this header, several lines describe the runtime status, including "Executable: Resolving...", "CODEX_HOME (configured): Resolving...", and "Live runtime data is accessed only throu...".
